kind: retrospective lineage audit plus assumption-based future statistical planning; not a new strategy registration
scope: Only these observed local equity artifacts. Do not certify all attempted hypotheses, human choices, or actual viewing chronology. Include cash/control/cost/capital/phase variants without treating account records as independent trials.
deduplication: Exact clock+normalized Decimal equity+currency equality only; equality or inequality is not a count of statistically independent tests.

power_model.method: Exact noncentral-t under the stated iid-normal model: critical=nct.ppf(1-alpha,n-1,S0*sqrt(n/F)); power=nct.sf(critical,n-1,S1*sqrt(n/F)); integer bisection for minimum n. Also show large-n z approximation.
power_model.applicability: Planning sensitivity only. No multiple-selection correction, dependence/heavy-tail robustness, drawdown certification, CAGR certification, or real forward evidence. Do not convert the best scenario into an admission target.

reason: Complete influential search history, correlation/selection structure and required comparable independent observations are not certified. Observed record count is not the missing trial input.
